lines.text: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD;
let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving;
let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
For the LORD is a great God,
a great King above all gods.
In His hand are the depths of the earth,
and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
The sea is His, for He made it,
and His hands formed the dry land.
O come, let us worship and bow down;
let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
and we are the people of His pasture,

pictures.scene: Hendrick ter Brugghen, Musicerend gezelschap bij kaarslicht — the players leaning in over lute and flute in the candlelight with their mouths open in song, come, let us sing for joy to the LORD and shout to the Rock of our salvation
pictures.name: pd_brugghen_zingen

pictures.scene: Gentile Bellini, Procession in St Mark's Square — the whole city walking in order with candles and canopy toward the open doors of the church, let us enter His presence with thanksgiving and make a joyful noise to Him in song
pictures.name: pd_bellini_dank

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crown held up in the hands of the Father and the Son with the dove above them, for the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_koning

pictures.scene: Alexandre Calame, Paysage avec petit lac de montagne — the little lake lying deep under the bare rock walls with the peaks standing over it, in His hand are the depths of the earth and the mountain peaks belong to Him
pictures.name: pd_calame_bergen

pictures.scene: Jacopo Tintoretto, The Creation of the Animals — the Creator sweeping forward over the water while the fish pour out into the sea and the birds rise over the land, the sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_zee

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Saint Francis in Meditation — the friar down on his knees in the dark with the skull held against his breast and his face lifted, O come, let us worship and bow down, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_knielen

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, Schafherde auf der Weide — the shepherd leaning on his staff with his dog beside him while the flock rests on the pasture under the wide light, for He is our God and we are the people of His pasture
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_weide

pictures.scene: Vittore Carpaccio, The Vision of Saint Augustine — the writer stopped at his desk with his pen lifted and his head turned toward the light coming in at the window, the sheep under His care: today, if you hear His voice
pictures.name: pd_carpaccio_stem
